allowedWork: Framework-neutral code-generation request and result protocols.
TypeScript-owned and Python-owned build-time frontend adapters, legality proofs, semantic binding, operations, recipe binding, corpora, and generated artifacts.
Tool-neutral discovery and compilation entrypoints, exact evidence, readiness, Transformation Coverage, scoped CLI, tests, bundle checks, and durable project records.
disallowedWork: Animation choreography, timing, CSS, renderer, layout, semantic IDs, motion plans, or canonical route changes.

Arbitrary refactoring or execution of untrusted source; universal AST or cross-language syntax semantics; Scheme, CodeMirror, binder, Graph3D, differentiation, integration, fraction, economics, public-layout, or live-model work.
Browser shipment of the TypeScript compiler or Python runtime; generic fades, inferred glyph correspondence, or silent fallback.
goal: Close the bounded extract-helper TypeScript and Python capabilities through language-owned build-time frontends, typed semantic legality, governed authoring, exact evidence, and unchanged canonical assets.
commitCadence: Commit each independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and its completed Theseus evidence; never stage protected economics files or unrelated user documents.
stopConditions: Stop if closing either frontend requires changing approved choreography, timing, CSS, renderer output, semantic IDs, motion plans, layout geometry, or canonical routes.
Stop if the TypeScript compiler or Python runtime becomes browser reachable, if arbitrary source execution is required, or if unsupported input cannot fail with a typed diagnostic.
Stop on unresolved semantic, identity, exact-seek, rewind, accessibility, visual, bundle-boundary, architecture, or generated-artifact drift.
Stop if a shared seam would erase language-owned syntax or legality, or if the exact extract-helper capability cannot be proven without expanding into deferred domains.

slices.title: Freeze-current-baseline

Both semantic artifacts, coverage, and type boundaries remain green; no presentation code changed.

slices.title: Code-refactor-request-protocol
slices.summary: Added an immutable framework-neutral code-refactor request/result protocol for exactly ordered before/after revisions and extract-helper intent. It composes opaquely under the cross-domain generation envelope, rejects syntax shortcuts and presentation policy, and imports no parser, semantic-model, editor, renderer, or framework authority.

slices.title: Typed-repair-diagnostics
slices.summary: Added a closed data-driven six-code semantic repair vocabulary with canonical phases and repair actions. Diagnostics carry stable revision/role evidence, serialize and freeze deterministically, reject duplicates and cross-language mixing, and provide no generic fallback category.
